title: Patroni: role inspection + grant
description: Runs `nexus acl postgres list` then `grant`: lists PG roles with their attribute flags; grant idempotently CREATE ROLEs a LOGIN role + GRANT CONNECT.

observe.what: nexus-cluster-admin shows LOGIN CREATEROLE CREATEDB REPLICATION; the bootstrapped postgres/nexusops/replicator/rewind roles are listed

whatProves: PatroniAdapter.AclAsync renders a \du-equivalent from pg_roles attribute flags and (grant) idempotently creates a LOGIN role.
